chunks: The believers, men and women, are allies of one another. They enjoin what is right and prohibit what is wrong. They observe their devotional obligations, pay the zakat, and obey God and His Apostle. God will be merciful to them, for God is all-mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءُ: Allies or close friends who support one another

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of believers mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah verse 71?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the concept of *Wilayah* (spiritual guardianship) among believers, extending beyond mere social cohesion to a theological bond of mutual accountability. The command to 'enjoin good and forbid evil' (*Amr bil-Ma'ruf wa Nahi anil-Munkar*) is viewed as a collective duty (*Fard Kifayah*) that reinforces the community's adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings. This mutual support is intrinsically linked to ritual observance, positioning spiritual obedience to God and the Prophet as the foundation of communal integrity.
